summary: Frontend-only regression on expanded 20-module CFAST battery. Dashboard renders all 20 module cards grouped by category with READY badges + Windows-95 aesthetic (navy background, grey panels, dark-red title bar). Admin page lists all 20 configurable modules with [+] expand toggles, Save/Reset/Clear buttons (Save toast 'Settings saved' confirmed). All 20 module routes (/module/<id>) load successfully via Practice + Easy + Continue -> Test screen shell (warning-list, clock-display, time-remaining) with ZERO JS errors. Cancel returns to dashboard. Assessment mode results screen (overall-score testid) renders and attempt is persisted in localStorage (aviation_aptitude_history) which is reflected on the dashboard card after refresh (Visual Search now shows ATTEMPTS=1). Cognitive Updating instruction phase via begin-instruction-phase-btn works. No React runtime crashes observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js imports `bevelIn` but never uses it (dead import).
cbtCommon.js `import React from 'react'` sits after other exports - non-idiomatic; move to top for consistency.
AdminSettings uses testid pattern `admin-toggle-<mKey>` (correct) but no matching test docs; ensure this stays stable for future testing agents.
seed_data_creation: One assessment attempt created in localStorage for visual-search module to verify persistence.
